proposals.before: They seized Ding Prefecture, then marched their entire force north.
proposals.after: Mada occupied Ding Prefecture, then led his entire force north.
proposals.reason: The prior unit makes Mada the expelled subject; the Chinese continues with Mada as the omitted subject, not Bai Zairong and his group.

decisions.reason: s0058 ends with 逐出麻荅; the zero-subject continuation 據定州，已而悉其衆以北 is Mada’s flight after expulsion, confirmed by s0060’s 麻荅者 biography. The prior idiomatic “They” wrongly keeps Bai Zairong’s group as agents; naming Mada and using singular “his” restores the correct subject.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 據定州，已而悉其衆以北
